newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key 182nd JGB yield falls to new low of 2.085 pct.
newsitem.headline: Key 182nd JGB yield falls to new low of 2.085 pct.

text.p: The benchmark 182nd Japanese government bond yield fell to a new low of 2.085 percent in early morning trade on Tuesday.
The previous low was 2.090 percent set on Monday.
The coupon rate of the 182nd 10-year JGB is three percent.
Traders said the yield of the 182nd JGB yield was driven down by the tight supply and demand balance in the cash bond market as well as buybacks by dealers.
The 182nd JGB yield fell had fallen as low as 2.080 percent as of 0112 GMT.
